note: Recorded generation response used offline (no token). Demonstrates SYS-010: at speed exactly 100, CNF-001 and CNF-002 conflict, so the scenario MUST stay UNDETERMINED and no expected value is asserted for that input.

scenarios.title: clearly below the threshold is not overspeed

oracle.statement: Below or at 100 km/h the alarm is inactive.

scenarios.title: clearly above the threshold is overspeed

oracle.statement: At or above 100 km/h the alarm is active.

scenarios.title: exactly at the threshold is contradictory

oracle.statement: At exactly 100 km/h the two requirements demand opposite results.
oracle.rationale: CNF-001 requires active (>=100) while CNF-002 requires inactive (<=100).
oracle.proposal: Resolve whether the equality case is overspeed (change CNF-002 to '< 100') or not (change CNF-001 to '> 100').
